title: Condensed rollout status cards — failure recovery microcopy & accessibility spec
creator: Sofia Nguyen
description: Design a compact/condensed variant of the rollout status card used in the Console 'Rollouts' list view. The goal is to create a space-efficient card that surfaces: current rollout phase, health indicator, last-failed step (if any) with concise recovery microcopy, and a small contextual action (Retry / Details). The scope includes visual polish for the condensed layout, motion brief for state transitions (deploying -> healthy -> degraded -> failed), and an accessibility spec for aria announcements and keyboard focus behavior. Deliverables: Figma comps for compact card (default/hover/expanded), prototype of transition micro-animations, written microcopy alternatives for localization, and an accessibility checklist for handoff to engineering and QA.
acceptance_criteria: Compact card renders within 56px row height without text truncation for English strings
When state changes (deploying -> healthy/degraded/failed) the aria-live region announces concise update to screen readers
Color contrast for status chips meets AA for normal text and 3:1 for graphical elements per WCAG 2.1 when displayed in compact mode
Retry action opens the rollout detail modal and preserves keyboard focus order
No visual jitter when multiple cards update simultaneously (test with 50 concurrent updates in staging)
All microcopy has localization keys defined and reviewed by i18n owner
review_comments: PM (Daniel Ruiz) 2026-03-03: Prefer 'Attempt rollback' vs 'Retry' — requested options be wire-framed; asked for a 2-line max microcopy for failure reasons

Design Review (Marcus Lee) 2026-03-07: Visual polish pass applied to chip radius and shadow; noted cost/space trade-offs and requested two density variants (compact and ultra-compact) for PM to decide
QA Lead (Lena Torres) 2026-03-09: Added edge-case test: network flaps during rollouts should show 'Pending retry' microcopy and keep Retry disabled until stabilization
decisions_and_tradeoffs: Use single shared aria-live region at top of rollouts list to reduce screen reader noise — tradeoff: slightly less granular announcements but better UX for screen reader users
Prefer concise 1-line failure microcopy in compact card with an optional tooltip for full error details — tradeoff: increases discoverability burden but preserves compact layout
Animation duration capped at 160ms for state transitions to reduce perceived latency while keeping CPU cost low on low-end clients
qa_checklist: Verify compact card fits in 56px row on desktop at 100% zoom
Simulate state transitions and confirm no layout shift > 2px
Screen reader test: NVDA/VoiceOver confirm single announcement per relevant state change
Keyboard only: Tab flows to Retry button and to details modal close in correct order
Color contrast verification against light/dark themes
Localization smoke: verify microcopy keys render for Spanish and German locales
